facts.big: Take off… · Put it in a tray · No liquids
facts.label: Passar pela segurança
facts.sub: Ouça Boarding pass and ID, please e Take off your shoes. Pergunte Do I take out my laptop? Entenda No liquids over three ounces. Diga I understand e pergunte Where do I put my shoes on?

facts.label: Fila de segurança
facts.sub: Antes do portão, todos passam por um posto de segurança. Você mostra o cartão de embarque e o documento a um agente e segue as instruções.

facts.label: Regra dos líquidos
facts.sub: Os líquidos precisam estar em frascos de até cem mililitros e dentro de uma sacola transparente. Frascos maiores têm de ficar na mala despachada.

paragraphs: It is eight o’clock in the morning at the airport in Atlanta. A long line of people moves toward the security gates. Rui holds his boarding pass and his passport. He watches the people in front of him carefully. At the front, a security agent named Kim waits. She speaks fast but clearly.
“Next, please. Boarding pass and ID.” says Kim. “Here you go.” says Rui. “Take off your shoes and your belt.” says Kim.
